summary: Regression testing of GET /api/tasks N+1 optimization. 30/30 backend tests pass (24 existing + 6 new focused regression). Verified that after the batch-query refactor (per-user completions loaded once into by_task dict), today_status still maps correctly to 'todo' (no completion), 'pending' (photo task, waiting vote), 'approved' (auto-approve or peer-approved), and today_completion_id is populated only when a completion exists. Confirmed: (1) Léa login + GET /api/tasks returns all her assigned daily/weekly tasks (Ranger sa chambre, Faire ses devoirs, Vider le lave-vaisselle, Nettoyer la salle de bain, etc.) with today_status='todo' initially; (2) POST /api/tasks/{id}/complete on non-photo task auto-approves, GET /api/tasks reflects today_status='approved' with correct today_completion_id, and GET /api/auth/me points increased by exact points_worth; (3) duplicate same-day completion returns 409; (4) soft-deleted tasks (active=false) are excluded from GET /api/tasks for both kid and parent; (5) Parent PIN + peer-vote flow unchanged — pending photo completion is visible via /api/completions/pending and parent approval flips today_status from 'pending' to 'approved'. No regressions detected from the N+1 optimization.

minor.issue: Signature declares an Optional `token` query param but never uses it — auth still only reads the Authorization header. React Native <Image> can't send Authorization headers on web, so proof photos may 401 in browser preview. (Pre-existing from iteration_1.)
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Prefer lifespan context manager. (Pre-existing.)

action_items: No action required for the N+1 refactor — behavior is identical to the pre-refactor loop.
(Carry-over) Honor `?token=` query in GET /api/photos/{path} so RN <Image> can render proofs on web.
(Carry-over) Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown to lifespan handlers.
critical_code_review_comments: list_tasks (server.py:326-339) correctly builds by_task = {c['task_id']: c for c in comps} scoped by family_id + user_id + today day_key; O(N+M) instead of O(N*M). Semantics identical to previous find_one loop.

Query filter {'active': {'$ne': False}} correctly includes seeded tasks (which have active=True) AND legacy tasks with no `active` field, while excluding soft-deleted ones. Verified in test_soft_deleted_task_excluded_from_list.
today_completion_id is set to None (not missing) when no completion exists — good for frontend nullability handling.
Compound index on (task_id, user_id, day) created at startup makes the batch query efficient.
seed_data_creation: All test-created tasks/rewards use TEST_ prefix and are torn down in try/finally or explicit delete calls. No persistent test data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: N+1 optimization in GET /api/tasks fully verified. Regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_tasks_regression.py can be reused for future refactors touching list_tasks. Full suite 30/30 in ~5s. Credentials & PIN unchanged.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. Refactor preserves behavior.
